info.title: C-Trace API
info.description: Trace every tonne. Verifiable carbon MRV for factories. Every number traces to a source document and a cited factor.

get.summary: Who am I (verified token → C-Trace user, organisation, role)

schema.title: Response List Factories V1 Factories Get
Response Create Factory V1 Factories Post
Response Get Factory V1 Factories  Factory Id  Get
Response Add Asset V1 Factories  Factory Id  Assets Post
Response Add Intervention V1 Factories  Factory Id  Interventions Post
Response Get Production V1 Factories  Factory Id  Production Get
Response Put Production V1 Factories  Factory Id  Production Put
Response Upload Production Csv V1 Factories  Factory Id  Production Csv Post

post.summary: Upload bills (PDF/JPEG/PNG). Re-uploading identical bytes is idempotent (SHA-256).

schema.title: Response Upload Documents V1 Factories  Factory Id  Documents Post
Response List Documents V1 Factories  Factory Id  Documents Get

post.summary: Start a private live-demo sandbox (fictional data) and get a demo token

schema.title: Response Start Demo V1 Demo Start Post

post.summary: First sign-in: create your C-Trace account and organisation

schema.title: Response Get Document V1 Documents  Document Id  Get
Response Get Job V1 Jobs  Job Id  Get
Response List Records V1 Factories  Factory Id  Activity Records Get

get.summary: Correction suggestions (implied tariff far from this factory's median). Each needs an explicit accept.

schema.title: Response List Suggestions V1 Factories  Factory Id  Suggestions Get
Response Confirm V1 Activity Records  Record Id  Confirm Post
Response Correct V1 Activity Records  Record Id  Correct Post
Response Reject V1 Activity Records  Record Id  Reject Post
Response Record Audit V1 Activity Records  Record Id  Audit Get

get.summary: Trace ledger: every row links to its bill and factor

schema.title: Response Get Ledger V1 Factories  Factory Id  Ledger Get

schema.title: Response Get Summary V1 Factories  Factory Id  Summary Get
Response List Factors V1 Factors Get

schema.title: Response Add Official Factor V1 Admin Factors Post

get.summary: Monthly temperature and cooling degree days, with source

schema.title: Response Get Weather V1 Factories  Factory Id  Weather Get

get.summary: Climate TRACE sector context: where the factory's annualised Scope 1 sits (a signal, not a grade)

schema.title: Response Get Benchmark V1 Factories  Factory Id  Benchmark Get

get.summary: Public datasets C-Trace uses, with URL, licence and retrieval time

schema.title: Response Data Sources V1 Data Sources Get

post.summary: Run the C-Trace Verifier on the factory's current data (expected band, drivers, grades)

schema.title: Response Run Verification V1 Factories  Factory Id  Verification Run Post

get.summary: Latest verification run (stale if data changed since)

schema.title: Response Get Verification V1 Factories  Factory Id  Verification Get

schema.title: Response Resolve Month V1 Verification  Run Id   Period  Resolve Post

get.summary: C-Trace Verifier drift checks across the fleet (platform admins)

schema.title: Response Get Drift V1 Admin Drift Get
